0022600160.text: The Hawks (3-3, on a one-game win streak and 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) visit the Pacers (2-4, on a three-game losing streak, 12th in the East and 3 games back in the Central). Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Hawks won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, and the Pacers beat Atlanta 129-124 in Indianapolis on 2026-01-31.
